cases.title: Verify existence of Classic and Modern themes under themes preferences
cases.description: Preconditions: The browser application is running. Steps: Access the themes preferences section. Expected: Both Classic and Modern themes exist under the themes preferences.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences menu item availability
cases.description: Preconditions: The browser application is running. Steps: Click on the View menu. Expected: The Theme Preferences item is available under the View menu.

cases.title: Verify Get New Themes menu item availability
cases.description: Preconditions: The browser application is running. Steps: Click on the View menu. Expected: The Get New Themes item is available under the View menu.

cases.title: Verify Classic menu item availability
cases.description: Preconditions: The browser application is running. Steps: Click on the View menu. Expected: The Classic item is available under the View menu.

cases.title: Verify Modern menu item availability
cases.description: Preconditions: The browser application is running. Steps: Click on the View menu. Expected: The Modern item is available under the View menu.

opinions.feedback: The provided cases lack test coverage for R-176 and R-177, which require visual verification of the Classic and Modern themes against given images. Revision is requested to add cases covering R-176 and R-177.
confirmed_blockers: Requirements R-176 and R-177 are missing test case coverage.

analysis.analysis: Based on the validator feedback, requirements R-176 and R-177 depend on an external image reference that is not supplied, making the expected visual display untestable. All other requirements R-175, R-178, R-179, R-180, and R-181 remain valid and testable.
